005package org.wpilib.util.container;
006
007import static org.wpilib.util.ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam;
008
009import java.lang.ref.WeakReference;
010import java.util.AbstractSet;
011import java.util.ArrayList;
012import java.util.Collection;
013import java.util.Iterator;
014import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
015import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
016import java.util.SequencedSet;
017import java.util.Spliterator;
018import java.util.Spliterators;
019
020/**
021 * A variant of {@link java.util.LinkedHashSet} with weak references to entries. This container will
022 * not prevent its entries from being garbage collected, unlike a typical {@code Set}. Null elements
023 * are not permitted; calling {@link #add(Object) add(null)} will always throw a {@code
024 * NullPointerException}.
025 *
026 * @param <E> The type of elements in the set.
027 * @see java.util.LinkedHashSet
028 * @see WeakReference
029 */
030public final class WeakLinkedHashSet<E> extends AbstractSet<E> implements SequencedSet<E> {
031  private final LinkedHashMap<WeakKey<E>, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
032  private static final Object PRESENT = new Object();
033
034  /**
035   * Constructs a new, empty linked hash set with the default initial capacity (16) and load factor
036   * (0.75).
037   */
038  public WeakLinkedHashSet() {
039    super();
040  }
041
042  /**
043   * Constructs a new linked hash set with the same elements as the specified collection. The linked
044   * hash set is created with an initial capacity sufficient to hold the elements in the specified
045   * collection and the default load factor (0.75).
046   *
047   * @param collection the collection whose elements are to be placed into this set
048   * @throws NullPointerException if the specified collection is null
049   */
050  public WeakLinkedHashSet(Collection<? extends E> collection) {
051    requireNonNullParam(collection, "collection", "WeakLinkedHashSet");
052    addAll(collection);
053  }
054
055  @Override
056  public boolean add(E e) {
057    requireNonNullParam(e, "e", "WeakLinkedHashSet.add");
058
059    purgeCollected();
060    return map.putLast(new WeakKey<>(e), PRESENT) == null;
061  }
062
063  @Override
064  public void addFirst(E e) {
065    requireNonNullParam(e, "e", "WeakLinkedHashSet.addFirst");
066
067    purgeCollected();
068    map.putFirst(new WeakKey<>(e), PRESENT);
069  }
070
071  @Override
072  public void addLast(E e) {
073    requireNonNullParam(e, "e", "WeakLinkedHashSet.addLast");
074
075    purgeCollected();
076    map.putLast(new WeakKey<>(e), PRESENT);
077  }
078
079  @Override
080  public boolean remove(Object o) {
081    requireNonNullParam(o, "o", "WeakLinkedHashSet.remove");
082
083    purgeCollected();
084    return map.remove(new WeakKey<>(o)) != null;
085  }
086
087  @Override
088  public boolean contains(Object o) {
089    requireNonNullParam(o, "o", "WeakLinkedHashSet.contains");
090
091    purgeCollected();
092    return map.containsKey(new WeakKey<>(o));
093  }
094
095  @Override
096  public int size() {
097    purgeCollected();
098    return map.size();
099  }
100
101  // Removes entries where the element has been garbage collected
102  private void purgeCollected() {
103    map.keySet().removeIf(key -> key.get() == null);
104  }
105
106  @Override
107  public Iterator<E> iterator() {
108    purgeCollected();
109    return new WeakKeyIterator(map.keySet().iterator());
110  }
111
112  @Override
113  public SequencedSet<E> reversed() {
114    purgeCollected();
115
116    return new ReversedView<>(this, map.sequencedKeySet().reversed());
117  }
118
119  @Override
120  public Spliterator<E> spliterator() {
121    return Spliterators.spliteratorUnknownSize(
122        iterator(), Spliterator.DISTINCT | Spliterator.ORDERED | Spliterator.NONNULL);
123  }
124
125  private static final class WeakKey<T> extends WeakReference<T> {
126    private final int m_hashCode;
127
128    WeakKey(T referent) {
129      super(referent);
130      m_hashCode = referent.hashCode();
131    }
132
133    @Override
134    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
135      if (!(obj instanceof WeakKey<?> other)) {
136        return false;
137      }
138
139      T ref = get();
140      return ref != null && ref.equals(other.get());
141    }
142
143    @Override
144    public int hashCode() {
145      return m_hashCode;
146    }
147  }
148
149  private class WeakKeyIterator implements Iterator<E> {
150    private final ArrayList<WeakKey<E>> keys = new ArrayList<>();
151    private int nextIndex;
152    private E nextElement = null;
153    private E lastReturnedElement = null;
154
155    WeakKeyIterator(Iterator<WeakKey<E>> mapIterator) {
156      mapIterator.forEachRemaining(keys::add);
157    }
158
159    @Override
160    public boolean hasNext() {
161      while (nextElement == null && nextIndex < keys.size()) {
162        WeakKey<E> key = keys.get(nextIndex++);
163        nextElement = key.get();
164        if (nextElement == null) {
165          map.remove(key);
166        }
167      }
168      return nextElement != null;
169    }
170
171    @Override
172    public E next() {
173      if (!hasNext()) {
174        throw new NoSuchElementException();
175      }
176      E element = nextElement;
177      lastReturnedElement = element;
178      nextElement = null;
179      return element;
180    }
181
182    @Override
183    public void remove() {
184      if (lastReturnedElement == null) {
185        throw new IllegalStateException();
186      }
187
188      map.remove(new WeakKey<>(lastReturnedElement));
189      lastReturnedElement = null;
190    }
191  }
192
193  private static class ReversedView<E> extends AbstractSet<E> implements SequencedSet<E> {
194    private final WeakLinkedHashSet<E> originalSet;
195    private final SequencedSet<WeakKey<E>> reversedKeys;
196
197    ReversedView(WeakLinkedHashSet<E> originalSet, SequencedSet<WeakKey<E>> reversedKeys) {
198      this.originalSet = originalSet;
199      this.reversedKeys = reversedKeys;
200    }
201
202    @Override
203    public int size() {
204      return originalSet.size();
205    }
206
207    @Override
208    public Iterator<E> iterator() {
209      return originalSet.new WeakKeyIterator(reversedKeys.iterator());
210    }
211
212    @Override
213    public SequencedSet<E> reversed() {
214      return originalSet; // Reversing a reversed view returns the original set
215    }
216
217    @Override
218    public boolean add(E e) {
219      return originalSet.add(e);
220    }
221
222    @Override
223    public boolean remove(Object o) {
224      return originalSet.remove(o);
225    }
226
227    @Override
228    public boolean contains(Object o) {
229      return originalSet.contains(o);
230    }
231
232    @Override
233    public void addFirst(E e) {
234      originalSet.addLast(e);
235    }
236
237    @Override
238    public void addLast(E e) {
239      originalSet.addFirst(e);
240    }
241
242    @Override
243    public E getFirst() {
244      return originalSet.getLast();
245    }
246
247    @Override
248    public E getLast() {
249      return originalSet.getFirst();
250    }
251
252    @Override
253    public E removeFirst() {
254      return originalSet.removeLast();
255    }
256
257    @Override
258    public E removeLast() {
259      return originalSet.removeFirst();
260    }
261
262    @Override
263    public Spliterator<E> spliterator() {
264      return Spliterators.spliteratorUnknownSize(
265          iterator(), Spliterator.DISTINCT | Spliterator.ORDERED | Spliterator.NONNULL);
266    }
267  }
268}
